=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
{{trans|Ring}}
{{libheader|SDL2}}
{{libheader|OpenGL}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">
#include once "SDL2/SDL.bi"
#include once "GL/gl.bi"
#include once "GL/glu.bi"

Const ScrW = 800, ScrH = 600
Const As Single PI = 4 * Atn(1.0)

Sub InitGL()
    glViewport(0, 0, ScrW, ScrH)
    glMatrixMode(GL_PROJECTION)
    glLoadIdentity()
    gluPerspective(45.0, ScrW / ScrH, 0.1, 100.0)
    
    glMatrixMode(GL_MODELVIEW)
    glLoadIdentity()
    
    glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST)
    glEnable(GL_CULL_FACE)
    glCullFace(GL_BACK)
    
    glEnable(GL_LIGHTING)
    glEnable(GL_LIGHT0)
    
    Dim lightPos(3) As Single = {10.0, 10.0, 10.0, 1.0}
    glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, @lightPos(0))
    
    Dim ambient(3) As Single = {0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1.0}
    Dim diffuse(3) As Single = {0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.0}
    glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_AMBIENT, @ambient(0))
    glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_DIFFUSE, @diffuse(0))
    
    glClearColor(245.0/255.0, 247.0/255.0, 250.0/255.0, 1.0)
End Sub

Sub DrawCube(size As Single)
    Dim s As Single = size / 2
    
    glBegin(GL_QUADS)
    ' Front (z+)
    glNormal3f(0, 0, 1)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s, s)
    glVertex3f( s, -s, s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s, s)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s, s)
    
    ' Back (z-)
    glNormal3f(0, 0, -1)
    glVertex3f( s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s, -s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s, -s)
    
    ' Left (x-)
    glNormal3f(-1, 0, 0)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s,  s)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s,  s)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s, -s)
    
    ' Right (x+)
    glNormal3f(1, 0, 0)
    glVertex3f( s, -s,  s)
    glVertex3f( s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s, -s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s,  s)
    
    ' Down (y-)
    glNormal3f(0, -1, 0)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f( s, -s, -s)
    glVertex3f( s, -s,  s)
    glVertex3f(-s, -s,  s)
    
    ' Up (y+)
    glNormal3f(0, 1, 0)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s,  s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s,  s)
    glVertex3f( s,  s, -s)
    glVertex3f(-s,  s, -s)
    glEnd()
End Sub

Sub DrawMenger(size As Single, level As Integer)
    If level = 0 Then
        DrawCube(size)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Dim newSize As Single = size / 3
    
    For dx As Integer = -1 To 1
        For dy As Integer = -1 To 1
            For dz As Integer = -1 To 1
                
                Dim cx As Integer = Iif(dx = 0, 1, 0)
                Dim cy As Integer = Iif(dy = 0, 1, 0)
                Dim cz As Integer = Iif(dz = 0, 1, 0)
                
                Dim hollow As Integer = cx + cy + cz
                
                If hollow >= 2 Then
                    ' hole
                Else
                    glPushMatrix()
                    glTranslatef(dx * newSize, dy * newSize, dz * newSize)
                    DrawMenger(newSize, level - 1)
                    glPopMatrix()
                End If
                
            Next dz
        Next dy
    Next dx
End Sub

' Main program
If SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO Or SDL_INIT_TIMER) <> 0 Then
    Print "SDL_Init error: "; *SDL_GetError()
    Sleep: End
End If

Dim ventana As SDL_Window Ptr = SDL_CreateWindow("Menger Sponge - FreeBASIC + SDL2 + OpenGL", SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, ScrW, ScrH, SDL_WINDOW_OPENGL Or SDL_WINDOW_SHOWN)

Dim glContext As SDL_GLContext = SDL_GL_CreateContext(ventana)
SDL_GL_SetSwapInterval(1)

InitGL()

' Main loop
Dim running As Boolean = True
Dim event As SDL_Event
Dim angle As Single = 0

While running
    While SDL_PollEvent(@event) <> 0
        If event.type = SDL_QUIT_ Then
            running = False
        Elseif event.type = SDL_KEYDOWN Then
            If event.key.keysym.sym = SDLK_ESCAPE Then running = False
        End If
    Wend
    
    angle += 0.5
    
    glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT Or GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT)
    
    glLoadIdentity()
    gluLookAt(10, 10, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0)
    
    glRotatef(angle, 0, 1, 0)
    
    DrawMenger(5.0, 2)
    
    SDL_GL_SwapWindow(ventana)
Wend

SDL_GL_DeleteContext(glContext)
SDL_DestroyWindow(ventana)</syntaxhighlight>
